title: Round 66 (F372): Town structure comparison - 0.map/02.map dense (wood_tilesc mid/front dominant) vs 3.map 沙巴克 sparse fortress (mid/front 255-dominant 171994/209506, wallsc 24 = 3384 cells in y211-405 band) + render verification
objective: Compare the three major EI towns' layer structures: 0.map (比奇城), 3.map (沙巴克), 02.map - quantifying density, wall placement, and render behavior.
question: What distinguishes 沙巴克 (3.map) from the other towns structurally?
method: Layer byte analysis of 0/3/02.map (back/mid/front counters); wall-cell spatial distribution; mapviewer tile renders + inspect_image.

0_map_比奇城.density: dense town - full mid/front wood_tilesc + cliffsc + smobjectsc

3_map_沙巴克.density: SPARSE fortress - mid/front 255-dominant (empty terrain), walls lib 24 (Wood/Wallsc) 3384 cells
3_map_沙巴克.walls: x 0..399, y 211..405 (inner keep wall band, NOT perimeter); edge walls only 4.9%

cell_analysis.render: 0/3/02.map tiles all 200 (88KB JPEGs); 3.map corner tile = open grass (walls only in y211-405 band)

audit_vs_exe.F371: 3.map OOB (3255) noted - sparse map still renders

contrast.dense_vs_fortress: 0/02.map = dense open town (objects everywhere); 3.map = empty terrain + isolated fortress wall band (y211-405)
contrast.wall_lib: 3.map uses lib 24 (Wood/Wallsc) - the only town with significant wall usage

verdict: Town structure comparison complete (primary-bytes): 0.map (比奇城) + 02.map = dense towns (wood_tilesc mid/front dominant, full object coverage); 3.map (沙巴克) = sparse fortress with 255-dominant mid/front (empty) + 3384 Wood/Wallsc cells forming an inner wall band (y211-405, not perimeter). All three render correctly.
evidence_level_note: Layer bytes + wall distribution read directly from the 3 map binaries; render verified visually.
tool: python3 struct scan; mapviewer HTTP; inspect_image
reproduce: scan back/mid/front of 0/3/02.map; extract lib-24 wall cells of 3.map; curl /tile
notes: 3.map 沙巴克 = classic fortress design: open ground + walled keep
wall cells x 0..399 full width but y confined 211-405 = horizontal wall band
0.map mid lib 0 (tilesc) 89189 = ground-detail overlay under objects (dense town signature)
